entities.name: AMF
entities.description: Access and Mobility Management Function that enforces forbidden wireline access area restrictions.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by AMF to reject registration when wireline access area is forbidden.

entities.name: SERVICE REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by AMF to reject service when wireline access area is forbidden.

entities.name: DEREGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by AMF to request deregistration when wireline access area is forbidden.

entities.name: 5GMM cause #77
entities.description: Cause value indicating 'wireline access area not allowed'.

entities.name: Forbidden area enforcement condition
entities.description: Conditions specified in 3GPP TS 23.316 for AMF's enforcement of forbidden area.

entities.name: 5G-RG
entities.description: 5G Residential Gateway that is restricted from accessing 5GCN when forbidden area condition is met.

entities.name: W-AGF acting on behalf of FN-CRG
entities.description: Wireline Access Gateway Function representing Fixed Network Customer Residential Gateway.

entities.name: W-AGF acting on behalf of N5GC device
entities.description: Wireline Access Gateway Function representing N5GC device.

entities.name: Access restriction behavior
entities.description: Condition where devices are prevented from accessing 5GCN over wireline access network.

relations.description: AMF sends REGISTRATION REJECT when forbidden area conditions are met.
AMF sends SERVICE REJECT when forbidden area conditions are met.
AMF sends DEREGISTRATION REQUEST when forbidden area conditions are met.
AMF enforcement is guarded by forbidden area conditions from TS 23.316.
Receipt of cause #77 establishes access restriction conditions for devices.
Access restriction prevents 5G-RG from accessing 5GCN until specific conditions are met.
Access restriction prevents W-AGF (FN-CRG) from accessing 5GCN until FN-CRG is switched off.
Access restriction prevents W-AGF (N5GC) from accessing 5GCN until FN-CRG serving it is switched off.
